title: 第202章 商会大比第201章 我主王腾有圣主之姿
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 与此同时，李幽若像是一匹黑马，正在疯狂驰骋！
“主人……我还可以吧？”
叶凡随口称赞一句：“不错，幽深！”
李幽若疑惑：“什么幽深？这也叫评价吗？”
下一秒。
女帝的尖叫声响彻！
一股耻辱的感觉传来，却更加兴奋！
这时，叶凡的储物戒指闪烁几下，他一个念头，一枚万里传音符从储物戒指里飞出来。
叶凡做了一个‘嘘’的动作，李幽若听话的捂着自己的嘴。
赛洛璃的声音传来：“叶凡，怎么样？什么时候回来？”
叶凡深吸一口气：“怎么了？中州出事了？”
赛洛璃一笑：“没事，大家都听你的话，留在天下第一拍卖行没有外出，那些人不敢触犯圣地定下的规矩，找不到机会。”
“我联系你，是因为另外一件事……咦？什么声音？叶凡，你在洗衣服吗？”
叶凡有些尴尬：“咳咳……我在洗脸呢，怎么了？”
赛洛璃的声音拉长，变得有些黏腻：“那你洗干净一点！”
“再过几天，神城五年一度的商会大比就要召开，星月圣地和太阴圣地一起当裁判，只要在商会大比中得到名次，我们天下第一拍卖行的名声可以借此打响！”
“打折出售东西，终究不是长久之计！做生意，名气大于一切。”
叶凡一笑：“商业上的事，你说了算。”
“你想让天下第一拍卖行参加这次商会大比？”
赛洛璃点头：“是的！”
“我和两位萧庄主，已经商议过，他们也同意。”
“所以，我就来联系你了，你觉得怎么样？”
叶凡闷哼一声，呼吸有些急促。
赛洛璃关切的问道：“叶凡，你怎么了？”
叶凡咳嗽两声：“没……没事……不小心踢到柜子了。”
“哦……那你小心一点！”
赛洛璃的声音拉的很长，继续说道：“历届商会大比都是抽签，比的就是商会的储存！调度！人脉！运气！还有物品的种类、数量！”
叶凡问道：“什么意思？”
赛洛璃解释：“很简单！”

At the same time, Li Youruo was like a dark horse, galloping crazily!
"Master...am I okay?"
Ye Fan casually complimented: "Not bad, deep!"
Li Youruo was confused: "What is deep? Is this also called evaluation?"
The next second.
"You...? Deep...! Ah——!"
The Empress's screams resounded!
A feeling of shame came, but even more excitement!
At this time, Ye Fan's storage ring flashed a few times, and with a thought, a ten-thousand-mile transmission note flew out of the storage ring.
Ye Fan made a 'shush' gesture, and Li Youruo obediently covered his mouth.
Sai Luoli's voice came: "Ye Fan, how are you? When will you come back?"
Ye Fan took a deep breath: "What's wrong? Something happened in Zhongzhou?"
Sai Luoli smiled: "It's okay. Everyone listens to your words and stays at the No. 1 auction house in the world. Those people don't dare to violate the rules set by the Holy Land and can't find a chance."
"I contacted you because of another thing... Huh? What's the sound? Ye Fan, are you washing clothes?"
Ye Fan was a little embarrassed: "Ahem... I'm washing my face, what's wrong?"
"Oh..."
Sailuo Li's voice became longer and thicker: "Then clean up a little!"
"In a few days, the Divine City's five-year Chamber of Commerce Competition will be held. Star-Moon Holy Land and Taiyin Holy Land will serve as referees together. As long as we get a ranking in the Chamber of Commerce Competition, our reputation as the best auction house in the world can be established!"
"Selling things at a discount is not a long-term solution after all! In business, reputation is more important than anything else."
Ye Fan smiled: "You have the final say on business matters."
"Do you want the No. 1 auction house in the world to participate in this chamber of commerce competition?"
Sai Luoli nodded: "Yes!"
"I have discussed it with the two village masters Xiao, and they agree."
"So, I came to contact you, what do you think?"
"Woo..."
Ye Fan groaned and breathed a little quickly.
Sai Luoli asked with concern: "Ye Fan, what's wrong with you?"
"Ahem..."
Ye Fan coughed twice: "No...it's okay...I accidentally kicked the cabinet."
"Oh...then be careful!"
Sailuo Li's voice was very long, and he continued: "All previous chamber of commerce competitions were drawn by lots, and what was compared was the chamber of commerce's storage! Scheduling! Connections! Luck! And the types and quantities of items!"
Ye Fan asked: "What do you mean?"
Sailuoli explained: "It's very simple!"
